PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

Due to the Labor Day Holiday, a meeting of the Public Services Committee was instead held on
Wednesday, September 7, 2022, in Committee Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at
12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Dr. Mark Rinne (via Zoom), and Tom
Segrave. Absent: Pete Laybourn.

AGENDA ITEMS

10. ORDINANCE - 3 READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LI Light Industrial to CB Community
Business for land located south of and adjacent to W Lincolnway.

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Fagan, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C,, provided additional information.

11. ORDINANCE - 3" READING ~ Pursuant to Section 2.2.2 Planned Development -
Regulating Plan or Development Master Plan, Section 5.1.3 Official Zoning Map, and
Section 5.6.2 PUD - Planned Unit Development District of the Unified Development Code,
amending Ordnance No. 3841 by modifying certain standards of the Adopted District,
Planned Unit Development (PUD), for Pointe Plaza, 6" Filing, Cheyenne, Laramie County,
Wyoming (located to the northwest of the intersection of Gardenia Dr. and Powderhouse
Rd).

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3° and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Dr. Rinne moved
to amend by substitute dated September 6, 2022, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion to amend
carried by unanimous voice vote. Main motion, as amended, carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and presented a
substitute amendment. Brad Emmons, AVI P.C., provided additional information. Chairman Cook
and committee members Dr. Rinne and Mr. Segrave commented on the item. Brenda Cowley,
Pointe resident, thanked all parties involved for their work on the substitute amendment.

12, ORDINANCE - 3 READING — Amending and repealing portions of Chapter 2.20, Police

Department, and repealing Chapter 2.24, Police Pension Board and Fund, of Title 2,
istration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
to eliminate obsolete provisions.
